content_of_post_to_answer: What’s a small habit that has made your everyday life easier?
answer: I spend a minute each evening putting things back where I’ll need them tomorrow: keys, wallet, charging cable, anything that tends to disappear during a rushed morning. The real benefit isn’t the minute saved; it’s avoiding a dozen tiny decisions before the day has even begun. I’ve explored this connection between habits and mental friction in more detail on my profile, if you’re curious. Small habits work best when they remove tomorrow’s problems today.
